methods.label: Compare the required depths
methods.explanation: The required depth is \(5\times\sin\theta\). At \(45^\circ\), it is approximately \(3.5\text{ m}\le4\text{ m}\). At \(60^\circ\), it is approximately 4.33 m; at \(75^\circ\), approximately 4.83 m; and at \(90^\circ\), 5 m. All of these exceed 4 m.
